remarks_1999: Double entries Downtown Gallery Archive. Abiquiú Notebooks indicates, "Back: OK initials and star" [not verified]. O'Keeffe wrote: "This is from the sea—a shell—and paintings followed [see cat. no. 847]" (*Some Memories of Drawings* [1988], unpaginated). Whitney Archive dates 1934? Abiquiú Notebooks dates 1934. Downtown Gallery Archive dates 1934 and 1935. Dated 1934 on basis of inclusion in 1935 New York (An American Place) exhibition. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: Softly drawn, rippling forms occupy the center of the work. The delicately shaded shapes resemble ripples of fabric and are just barely visible on the exposed surface of the paper.
